records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in revenue was primarily driven by lower volume in OFS and OFE, partially offset by higher volume in TPS and DS.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2021, equipment orders were up 3% and service orders were up 6%, compared to 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: DS revenue growth was affected by supply chain constraints that impacted product deliveries.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The oil markets experienced increasing levels of demand and continued restraints on supply translating into a strong oil price recovery.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Income before income taxes was $428 million in 2021, and included restructuring, impairment and other charges of $209 million, separation related costs of $60 million, a loss of $1,085 million related to our investment in C3 AI, partially offset by a gain of $241 million related to our investment in ADNOC Drilling, both recorded in other non-operating income/(loss).
